question: Anthurium Festival is celebrated to promote farmers, flowers and horticulture in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mizoram__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Anthurium festival of Mizoram** is one of the most popular festivals celebrated in the state.
 
• This festival is celebrated to promote tourism.
 
• The Anthurium Festival is organized annually by the Tourism Department in collaboration with the Horticulture Department.
 
• The Chapchar Kut is also regarded as the most popular spring festival for the people of the state.
 
• This festival is a public holiday in the state.
 
• Traditional bamboo dance - Cheraw and other dances were performed at the main event, attracting thousands of people.
 
• **Mizoram:**
 
 
• **State Animal** - Sumatran serow.
 
• **State Bird** - Mrs. Hume's pheasant.
 
• **National Parks** - Murlen National Park, Phawngpui National Park.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Festivals of Assam:**

 
 
• **​**Bihu is the harvest festival of Assam.
 
• Bihu marks the end of the harvesting season.
 
• Bihu is a set of three important Assamese festivals.
 
 
• Rongali or Bohag Bihu in April.
 
• Kongali or Kati Bihu in October.
 
• Bhogali or Magh Bihu in January.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Festivals of Manipur:**
 
 
• **​**Lai Haraoba.
 
• Kang Festival.
 
• Sangai Festival.
 
• Kut Festival.
 
• Cheiraoba Festival
 
 
 
• **Festivals of Nagaland:**
 
 
• **​**Hornbill Festival.
 
• Sekrenyi.
 
• Tsukheneye.
 
• Aoleang.
 
• Naknyulem
